package main

import "runtime"

type Obj struct{ data [512]byte }
type Holder struct{ Ref *Obj }

var keep *Obj

func main() {
	func() {
		o := &Obj{}
		// The cleanup argument is not o, but it points at o.
		runtime.AddCleanup(o, func(h *Holder) { _ = h }, &Holder{Ref: o})
	}()
	runtime.GC()
	runtime.GC()
}
